dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (I)
dialogues.text: "Pursued by mountain beasts, we villagers thought ourselves doomed, but we encountered the great adeptus..."

dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (I)
dialogues.text: "...Beauty beyond words, the like of which this world has never seen. Magnificent poise, for which no praises would be sufficient. A voice like timeless music, a song named Ling..."

dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (I)
dialogues.text: "...said: The divine rite approaches. Fujin has... I too... The jade that aforetime descended shall be divided, to prevent wicked spirits from plundering... offer it here, and you shall live at peace, to await..."

dialogues.speaker: Records of the Ancestors (I)
dialogues.text: "...The courtyard was sealed as per the adeptus's commands..."
